_comment: Seed fixture for the fix-available-pending-branch-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000005506 (Phase 4 free-htmx port — sixth port after
activity-log-htmx (MR !2334 / ka-0000004584), related-tickets-htmx
(MR !2346 / ka-0000005540), header-incident-summary-htmx
(MR !2347 / ka-0000005304), reporter-info-htmx (ka-0000004065), and
event-timeline-htmx (ka-0000000243)). Strategy A — port-then-soak:
lives alongside the Go-coded `fix-available-pending-branch` slug
(widgets_phase6.go) rather than replacing it. Authoring path:
kd create 'Free-htmx widget: fix-available-pending-branch-htmx' \
--type=widget-type \
-F gardenio/controller/cmd/beads-viewer/fixtures/fix-available-pending-branch-htmx.json
Pre-write hooks (kbeads/internal/server/widget_validation.go) parse
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
Unlike the previous five ports, the wire contract here does NOT mirror
the Go renderer 1:1. The Go path takes a raw unified `diff` string and
parses + chroma-highlights it server-side; the htmx template has no
diff parser or syntax-highlighter in scope, so the contract requires
producers to ship pre-structured `files[]` (path / language / adds /
dels / hunks → header / context / lines → kind / old_num / new_num /
text). Five intentional parity gaps documented in the port doc and in
TestFixAvailablePendingBranchParity:
1. Diff parsing — Go runs parseUnifiedDiff; htmx requires structured
files[]. Producers parse upstream (the gardener that emits the
widget-instance bead is best-placed to do this).
2. Syntax highlighting — Go runs chroma per line; htmx emits text
verbatim (auto-escaped). The diff CSS classes still apply, just
without the per-token spans.
3. Markdown summary — Go renders summary_markdown via goldmark; htmx
drops the field. Producers can pre-render and ship plain text.
4. Action buttons — Go emits Fast-track-merge + Open MR via
FastTrackMergeAction / OpenMRAction; htmx omits both. The
ii-w-pending-actions footer is present but empty.
5. CI status sanitization + commit_short — Go normalises CI status
and computes commit_sha[:7]; htmx emits both verbatim. Producers
should pre-normalize ci_status to {passed,failed,running,pending}
and pre-truncate to the desired short SHA length.
